reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 16 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution note and right-edge crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The returned note adds a third small gray-mark group/row below the two main upper rows and additional gray spots on the lower-right paper, changing the source's original two-row and largely blank-lower footprint. Remove the extra third group and lower spots while retaining only the source's original mark footprint.

The source's small dark right-edge tab is not retained as a distinct small tab; the return has only torn/notched paper contours. Restore the original small right-edge tab at its source position and scale.
entries.positive_observation: Short dark-brown brushed-back hair with a high forehead, receding temples and short sideburns remains. Dark brows, one stern closed mouth and a clean-shaven smooth chin remain without glasses, moustache or beard. The three-quarter viewer-right pose and rightward gaze are preserved. The olive-brown tunic retains two mustard-gold collar tabs/insignia and a dark central tie with no added medals. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar transition. The complete thin dark frame and opaque dark olive-charcoal backplate remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The added note marks and missing distinct small right-edge tab are the separate rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: The internal motifs of the two tiny collar insignia and note glyphs are unreadable at source scale. No rejection is based on those details; the extra third mark group, lower gray spots and missing distinct small tab are directly visible in native crops.
